subject: Pre-demo scoping questions and proposed times — Finly Labs
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <sam@finly.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Pre-demo scoping questions and proposed times — Finly Labs

Hi Samir,

Thanks for signing up and showing interest in Redwood — excited to connect. Before we lock a demo, a few quick questions so we tailor the session to your team (should only take a minute):

- Primary use case: are you focused on document summarization, extraction, chat, or something else?
- Expected peak concurrent requests and approximate tokens/month (ballpark is fine).
- Timeline: are you evaluating for a POC in the next 2–4 weeks, or a longer roadmap?
- Data sensitivity: will Finly send PII/financial documents to an external hosted API, or would you prefer a Private/VPC deployment?

If you prefer, I can propose a few 30-min slots this week — we can keep it short and demo a few model variants and cost/latency tradeoffs.

Proposed times (Eastern):
- Wed 10/20 — 11:00–11:30 AM ET
- Thu 10/21 — 2:30–3:00 PM ET
- Fri 10/22 — 9:00–9:30 AM ET

Also attaching a quick template if you want to paste usage numbers: Finly_usage_estimates.xlsx (just optional).

Thanks — I’ll follow up with Ben (SDR) to lock a time once you confirm availability.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai
Cal: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/30min

---
Attachment: Finly_usage_estimates.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: Samir Shah <sam@finly.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 13:58:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pre-demo scoping questions and proposed times — Finly Labs

Hi Stephanie — great to meet you virtually. Quick answers below: 

- Use case: automated summarization and entity extraction for investor reports and quarterly filings (legal + finance).
- Volume: we expect to process ~15k documents/month initially. Average doc ~2,000 tokens; rough estimate 30M tokens/month to start, could grow to ~120M/month over 6–9 months. Peak concurrency: occasional bursts during month-end processing — maybe 12–20 concurrent requests.
- Timeline: aiming for a 2-week POC starting late November, with production target in Q1.
- Data sensitivity: documents contain financial PII (names, account numbers). We prefer Private deployment or strict VPC controls; need details on KMS/HSM support and audit logs.

For times, Thu 10/21 2:30 PM ET works best for me. If that’s still open, please lock it. Thanks for the template — I’ll paste numbers in and send back.

Best,
Samir Shah
Head of ML Engineering — Finly Labs
sam@finly.ai
